host_boundaries.renderer_locations: explicit host manifest or caller output root
host_boundaries.font_discovery: explicit host roots; no bundled fonts
host_boundaries.runtime_wiring: host-owned; no gateway or provider activation

source_lineage.live_plugin: current docs plugin inspected read-only; candidate is not a byte-for-byte mirror
source_lineage.canonical_checker: canonical final-output-local-filter source copied into canonical_checker/
source_lineage.producer_inputs: public portable seam derived from quality rules and host contract; profile-local producer paths are not embedded

excluded_classes: task claims, VLR records, and runtime ledgers

verification_policy.offline_tests: canonical checker tests plus portable contract tests and existing quality suite
verification_policy.host_integration: representative local checker/producer readback with provider disabled
verification_policy.archive_receipt: external inventory and verification receipt bind member paths and SHA-256

recovery_boundary: quality-portable backup only; not full environment recovery
